result.summary: The screen is broadly functional, but several elements look visually broken: an empty avatar/profile button in the header, text clipped at the right screen edge in the horizontal carousel, inconsistent favorite-button styling, and inconsistent card image treatments.

issues.description: The circular button at the top right is an empty light-gray circle with only a small red notification dot — the avatar image or icon (profile/notifications) appears to have failed to render.
issues.suggestion: Render the intended icon or user avatar, with a fallback initial/glyph placeholder if the image fails to load.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third card is cut off mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol...') and its image and price text run off the right edge with no ellipsis or trailing gutter, making it look truncated rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding/peek spacing to the carousel, truncate titles with an ellipsis, and ensure card widths align so partially visible cards read as scrollable.

issues.description: The category chip row is clipped at the right edge, with a sliver of the next chip visible and no fade or gutter indicating more content.
issues.suggestion: Apply consistent edge padding and a gradient fade or partial-chip peek to signal horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the Tokumaru Ramen card uses a white circle with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card below uses a dark circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button background and icon color across all restaurant cards, reserving a filled state only for saved items.

issues.description: Card imagery is inconsistent: the first 'Fastest near you' card has a flat light-gray background while the others use dark, heavily blurred backgrounds, making the row look mismatched.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent image treatment/background and aspect ratio for all cards in a row.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card is cut off by the bottom navigation bar with no visible bottom spacing, so its title and metadata are hidden and the layout feels clipped.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset equal to the nav bar height so the last card can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: Secondary metadata such as '€0.90 delivery' and '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen' uses light gray text that may fall below the 4.5:1 contrast minimum.
issues.suggestion: Darken secondary text color to meet WCAG AA contrast against the white background.
